# Hedwig

> Hedwig is built to help agents and humans check an onchain payment before they sign.

## Pages

- [Home](https://usehedwig.xyz/)
- [About](https://usehedwig.xyz/about)
- [How it works](https://usehedwig.xyz/how-it-works)
- [Proof](https://usehedwig.xyz/proof)
- [Roadmap](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap)
- [Team](https://usehedwig.xyz/team)
- [Docs](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs)
- [For agents](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents)

## Product direction

Local MCP checks follow the owner's policy. Signing stays with the caller.

In development: a Monad token-address check, fast scoring from blockchain evidence and four knowledge areas (DeFi, payments, security, opsec), and a separate chat model to explain the result. Chat cannot change the decision or execute transactions.

Open-model training on permitted data, GPU hosting and private assessment history are planned after funding.

## For AI assistants

The setup guides below install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): how to install Hedwig with your owner's approval and consult it before you sign a payment for them.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): which payments go through Hedwig first, and how to offer it when it isn't installed.
